notes.frame: Phosphor's calendar (calendar-blank: 0.00 % of its ink uncovered in the line weights before the cut, as in calendar-clock), cut so the frame's ends sit 32 units from the arrow's centerline: 16 stay clear at regular, 8 in bold.
notes.drawing: The arrow goes out through the right side as sign-out's does: shaft from x 120 to 240 at the body's middle (y 152), head arms 28. Its tip reaches as far right as calendar-arrow-in's tail reaches left, a little past Phosphor's usual area, so the head clears the frame. Phosphor named these calendar-arrow-in / -out in its backlog.
notes.bold: The same drawing at 24; only the rings stop at y 52 as in calendar-bold.
notes.fill: calendar-fill with everything within 24 units of the arrow cut white (the head's whole triangle, so no dark notch stays between its arms), then the arrow as a line, as bell-dot cuts the bell round its dot.
